scientific_review.evidence_review_basis: Each retained assertion and populated qualifier is supported inside its own saved span. GST/HO-1 and PI3K/AKT spans begin at the SFPQ overexpression result sentence, supplying their actor and AD-mouse setting. The longer PI3K/AKT spans are needed to link the subsequent ratio result to SFPQ, not expanded for AAV metadata.
flags: No known unsupported new edges or metadata. No title/abstract near-duplicate result edge. All seven inspected outcome effects fields are empty.
